meta.title: Real-time Visual Identification System: alerts module and integration

tasks.title: Foundation: tracking window, ports, environment, Supabase access
Phasedoc plan DB, plan of record, architecture, mirror
tasks.acceptance: `phasedoc/plan.cmd tree` prints P0-P6 and phasedoc/BUILDPLAN.md exists

tasks.title: Cockpit on 127.0.0.1:6801 under PM2, registered in the Port Registry
tasks.acceptance: pm2-start-cockpit.log ends RESULT PASS (health 200 before and after Restart-Service PM2); registry row 6801 exists

tasks.title: Server port 8010 registered; Python venv with pinned requirements for server + AI module
tasks.acceptance: `.venv\Scripts\python -c "import cv2,fastapi,uvicorn,numpy"` exits 0; registry row 8010 exists

tasks.title: Supabase URL and publishable key in .env (from teammate); schema of missing_persons and storage bucket documented
tasks.acceptance: `python server/tools/supabase_check.py` prints HTTP 200 for the missing_persons select and lists the bucket name; docs/supabase.md records column names

tasks.title: Alert engine (Module 3 logic)
Detection event model and SQLite store (insert, list with filters and paging, count)
tasks.acceptance: `python -m pytest server/tests/test_store.py` passes: insert 25 events, filter by person/camera/date, page size, count

tasks.title: Match verification gate: minimum confidence, per-person cooldown, rejects malformed results
tasks.acceptance: test_gate.py passes: below-threshold rejected, repeat inside cooldown dropped, repeat after cooldown accepted, missing field rejected with reason

tasks.title: Alert dispatcher: fan-out to channels, one failing channel never blocks the others
tasks.acceptance: test_dispatch.py passes: 3 fake channels, one raises; the other two still receive the alert and the failure is logged

tasks.title: Optional Telegram channel, off by default
tasks.acceptance: test_telegram.py passes against a local fake HTTP server: message sent when enabled, nothing sent when disabled, no token appears in logs

tasks.title: Backend server: the interface the frontend already expects
FastAPI app: /health, /api/system/status
tasks.acceptance: curl /health returns 200; curl /api/system/status returns JSON with monitoring, activeCamera, aiService

tasks.title: Operator auth: /api/auth/signup and /api/auth/login with hashed passwords and signed tokens; all other routes require the token
tasks.acceptance: test_auth.py passes: signup 200, duplicate 409, bad password 401, protected route without token 401, with token 200

tasks.title: GET /api/detections (list, filters, paging), /api/detections/count, evidence images served
tasks.acceptance: curl with token returns {items,total,page,pageSize} with camelCase fields from the frontend contract; sceneImageUrl returns image/jpeg

tasks.title: GET /api/persons?fields=id,name
tasks.acceptance: curl with token returns an array of {id,name} for every registered person

tasks.title: MJPEG live stream at /video/stream
tasks.acceptance: `curl -m 5 /video/stream` returns multipart/x-mixed-replace and at least 3 JPEG parts that decode

tasks.title: WebSocket /alerts pushes each accepted alert with the frontend payload shape
tasks.acceptance: test_ws.py passes: client connects with token, a dispatched alert arrives within 1 s; connect without token is refused

tasks.title: AI integration: Module 2 feeds Module 3
AI pipeline runs inside the server in a thread, headless, and exposes its latest annotated frame and state
tasks.acceptance: Server started on a video file: /api/system/status reports aiService up and monitoring active; /video/stream frames show boxes

tasks.title: on_match result goes through gate, store and dispatcher
tasks.acceptance: test_bridge.py passes with a sample AI result: one stored row, one WebSocket message, a second result inside cooldown is dropped

tasks.title: Supabase person sync: new rows are embedded into the reference store, deleted rows are removed, hot reload without restart
tasks.acceptance: Insert a test row with a photo in Supabase: within 30 s /api/persons lists it and the pipeline store length rises by 1; delete the row: it disappears

tasks.title: Config by environment: camera source, camera id, thresholds, cooldown, sync interval
tasks.acceptance: .env.example documents every key; server started with a changed key shows the new value in /api/system/status

tasks.title: Frontend wiring: mock mode off, real data
USE_MOCK comes from an env var; auth, detections, status and realtime call the real server
tasks.acceptance: With VITE_USE_MOCK=false, headless login succeeds against the server; History page renders rows from /api/detections; 0 console errors

tasks.title: Live feed panel shows the MJPEG stream; status badge follows /api/system/status
tasks.acceptance: Headless screenshot of the dashboard shows the stream image element loaded (naturalWidth > 0) and the badge text matches the API

tasks.title: Alert popup, alarm sound and browser notification on a live match
tasks.acceptance: Headless run: a dispatched alert makes the popup appear with person name and confidence within 2 s; audio element play() is called once

tasks.title: Server serves the built frontend, so one port serves the whole product
tasks.acceptance: `npm run build` succeeds; GET http://127.0.0.1:8010/ returns the app HTML; deep link /history returns it too

tasks.title: End to end proof and hardening
End-to-end: video of a registered person to alert in the browser
tasks.acceptance: Scripted run: server on a test video, person registered, headless browser logged in; within 20 s one alert popup, one History row, one evidence scene file; recorded in phasedoc/E2E-RESULTS.md

tasks.title: Negative end-to-end: a video of an unregistered person raises no alert
tasks.acceptance: Same script with a different face: 0 alerts, 0 History rows after 30 s

tasks.title: Failure handling: camera drop, Supabase unreachable, WebSocket drop and reconnect
tasks.acceptance: Each fault injected in turn: server stays up, /api/system/status reflects it, the dashboard recovers without reload; results in E2E-RESULTS.md

tasks.title: Security review: secrets, CORS, auth coverage, evidence access
tasks.acceptance: Checklist in docs/security.md with a command or test per line; `git grep` for keys finds none; unauthenticated evidence URL returns 401

tasks.title: Server under PM2 on 8010 and survives a service restart
tasks.acceptance: pm2-start-server.log ends RESULT PASS (health 200 before and after Restart-Service PM2)

tasks.title: Documentation and release
README, module docs and landing-site status table match the verified state
tasks.acceptance: Every row of the README status table has a matching ticked leaf or an honest open leaf; site/src/App.jsx status tags updated

tasks.title: Pushed to GitHub with the mirror committed; Pages site rebuilt
tasks.acceptance: `git status` clean; `gh run list -L 1` shows Deploy site success; Pages URL returns 200

tasks.title: Vault summary note and index entry for the arc
tasks.acceptance: 01-Projects/Real-time Visual Identification System/*.md exists with cockpit link; index.md lists it; log.md has an entry
